titles.title: Glory Be To The Righteous One

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I'm longing for the return of the Savior who paid my debt
With blood He saved my life and claimed my soul from death

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
For I know, the time is coming soon
Lord I wanna be ready for You, so hear my cry
With one voice, we will sing this song
To hasten the splitting sky, we let it rise

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
The Spirit and the Bride say, “Come”
Glory be to the Righteous One
We sing this song until You come
Glory be to the Righteous One

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I’m yearning for the return of the Lover who’s ravished me
He chased me down with jealous love, pursued my heart
I'm preparing for the Fairest of Bridegrooms to take my hand
With love He stole, my heart and soul, He won’t let go

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
It doesn’t matter what the world is singing
I will lift my voice until I see Him
It doesn’t matter what the world is screaming
I know He’s coming soon and so I’m singing
